explanation: I found no matching Mathlib declaration. The theorem is about the library's own definitions (`IsoGraph.Canon.Part`, `Part.WF`, `individualize`, `Refines`, `IndivData`), which are partition data structures for graph canonization. Its proof uses only the library's own lemmas (`individualize_cst_getElemD`, `IndivData.cst_eq`) plus `omega`. Mathlib, Batteries and Lean core have no counterpart for these structures, so I did not search further.
